query:
INSERT INTO plans (id, key, features, limits, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3::text::jsonb, $4::text::jsonb,
                 timestamptz 'epoch' + $5::bigint * interval '1 microsecond',
                 timestamptz 'epoch' + $5::bigint * interval '1 microsecond')
         ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING
